risk_if_not_implemented: Without Vulnerabilities Related To Incidents, security incidents may not be detected, contained, investigated or communicated in a timely manner, increasing their scope, duration and cost. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Exposure from Unaddressed Vulnerabilities (R-EX-6), Incident Persistence / Recurrence (R-IR-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Incident Stakeholder Reporting
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to timely-report incidents to applicable:
(1) Internal stakeholders; 
(2) Affected clients & third-parties; and
(3) Regulatory authorities.
compensating_control_1.justification: Incident Stakeholder Reporting (IRO-16) provides incident response capability that compensates for the absence of Vulnerabilities Related To Incidents (IRO-16.4) by enabling timely detection, containment, and recovery from security events in the absence of the primary control. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Contacts With Authorities
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and document appropriate contacts with relevant law enforcement and regulatory bodies.
compensating_control_2.justification: Contacts With Authorities (GOV-15) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Vulnerabilities Related To Incidents (IRO-16.4) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
